summary: Ansible modules return a data structure that can be registered into a variable; this reference covers return values common to all modules, some of which Ansible itself sets.
questions: What keys can I expect in a registered task result?
Where are the return values common to all modules documented?

answer_card.title: Common module return values
answer_card.answer_md: Module results can be saved with `register:` and printed with `debug`. Besides module-specific keys (see `ansible-doc <module>`), common keys include `changed`, `failed`, `msg`, `rc`, `stdout`/`stdout_lines`, `stderr`/`stderr_lines`, `results` (loops), `diff`, `invocation`, `backup_file`. Some are added by Ansible itself.
